owner_hypothesis: После устойчивой проторговки у подтвержденного горизонтального или наклонного уровня торговать только исполнимый импульс выхода, отдельно для long и short.

data_contract.universe: point-in-time Bybit linear perps with listing timestamps

balance_definition: at least two alternating boundary interactions
level_context: horizontal support or resistance with timestamped touches
sloped level only when pivot anchors and unbroken validation are persisted
frozen_families.long_trigger: close above balance high plus 0.10 ATR, then executable retest or next-bar continuation
frozen_families.short_trigger: close below balance low minus 0.10 ATR, then executable retest or next-bar continuation
frozen_families.false_break_guard: reject immediate close back inside balance before fill
frozen_families.costs: two-sided Bybit fee, spread, slippage and missed maker fills

decision_rule: FAIL if activity, costs or OOS gates fail. PASS means shadow-only eligibility, never direct money promotion.
next_artifact: event ledger with exact balance bounds, level anchors, trigger, fill assumption, MFE, MAE and blocker reason
